can.runs: dune test (or dune runtest, dune build @runtest)

action-pinning.message: all 5 actions are pinned to a commit

ci-lint.message: CI lints its configuration (GitHub Actions: actionlint, zizmor)

ci-present.message: CI configuration found for GitHub Actions

code-formatting.message: .ocamlformat is defined and CI runs ocamlformat

compiler-warnings.message: strict OCaml warning settings are enabled: dune's dev profile warning set (or -w +a)

copy-paste-detection.message: CI runs copy-paste detection with jscpd

coverage.message: branch coverage is reported with bisect_ppx

dependency-updates.message: automated dependency updates are configured with Dependabot

large-files.message: no committed file is larger than 5 MiB

license.message: the project is licensed under MIT

platform-matrix.message: CI covers 3 OS(es) (linux, macos, windows), 2 OCaml version(s) (4.14, 5.2), 6 combination(s)

secret-scanning.message: secrets are scanned for with gitleaks

security-policy.message: SECURITY.md says how to report a vulnerability

security-scanning.message: CI scans the code for security problems with semgrep

status-badges.message: README.md shows CI (GitHub Actions) and quality (Codecov) badges

warnings-as-errors.message: warnings are treated as errors with dune's dev profile (or -warn-error +a)
